hints.title: Equal values make equal branches
hints.body: If two equal values are available at the same choice point, picking either one leads to the same subset values. Make that choice only once.

hints.title: Sorting exposes duplicates
hints.body: After sorting, equal values are adjacent. A branch that starts with a value equal to the previous value can be skipped at that level.

hints.title: Every path is a subset
hints.body: Record the current path at the beginning of every recursive call. Then try each later index as the next value. Skip an index when it repeats the previous value at the same level.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
sort nums
result = []
path = []

explore(start):
    result.push(copy of path)
    for i from start to nums.length - 1:
        if i > start and nums[i] == nums[i - 1]:
            continue
        path.push(nums[i])
        explore(i + 1)
        path.pop()

explore(0)
return result
```
